name: cache-clock
description: For the Claude Desktop app's Code tab: shows how long each chat's prompt cache stays warm

keepWarm.title: Keep warm by default
keepWarm.description: New chats start with keep-warm on: shortly before the cache expires, one small request reads it and resets its timer. Each chat can switch it with its band button or /keep-warm.

keepWarmMax.title: Keep-warm refreshes per idle stretch
keepWarmMax.description: How many refreshes keep-warm sends after your last message (each 1h refresh holds it about an hour longer); when they are spent, it compacts the chat if compacting is on, or lets it go cold with the expiry alert. While a workflow or background agent of the chat is still running, it keeps refreshing for as long as that costs less than re-caching the chat.

autoCompact.title: Compact before it goes cold
autoCompact.description: New chats start with compacting on: shortly before the cache expires (2 minutes before, 1 for a 5m cache), while it is still warm, the chat is compacted, so your next message writes only the summary instead of the whole history. With keep-warm on, that happens once its refreshes are spent; with it off, right away (chats under 30k tokens are left alone). Each chat can switch it with its band button. Off also stops Claude Code's own idle compaction in that chat, as does keep-warm while it still refreshes.

alert.title: Expiry alert
alert.description: What happens when about 5 minutes of cache time are left (1 minute for a 5m cache) and keep-warm is off.

otherChats.title: Show other chats
otherChats.description: List the caches of your other chats in the band.

reward.title: Warm-cache reward
reward.description: When a message you send reuses the warm cache, a little Clawd celebrates what it saved in the band, with sound: a prop on most messages, an hourglass flip on a close call, the guitar on a milestone.

stats.title: Show cache stats
stats.description: New chats show the cache stats box under the cache line. Each chat can switch it with its band button.
